steps.title: Load transfer CSV file
steps.instruction: Upload the CSV file that lists, for each transfer, the custom volume, the source location in one of the four Opentrons 24‑tube racks, and the destination tube location in the 96‑tube rack.

steps.title: Transfer serum reagent
steps.instruction: Using a p300 single‑channel pipette, transfer the volume of serum reagent specified in the CSV from each indicated source tube in the 24‑tube racks to the corresponding destination tube in the 96‑tube rack.

steps.title: Transfer RNase A
steps.instruction: Using a p20 single‑channel pipette, transfer the volume of RNase A specified in the CSV to the same destination tubes in the 96‑tube rack.

steps.title: Transfer Tween 20 and mix
steps.instruction: Using a p20 single‑channel pipette, transfer the volume of 20 % Tween 20 specified in the CSV to the destination tubes, then mix the tube contents (e.g., by pipette up/down).

steps.title: Incubate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Hold the 96‑tube rack at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Notify user of completion
steps.instruction: Send a notification to the user indicating that the 30‑minute room‑temperature incubation is complete.
